observations.finding: The observed learning window contains 50 nodes, t=0.00 through 0.49, within the declared [0,0.5] window. Regional moments concern predicted endpoint coordinates in the supplied world-Angstrom representation, not current physical atom velocities. Their statistical unit is equal batches after equal child averaging within extant parent and score stratum. Survival support comprises 14 batches; terminal state time is 1.00 and terminal score time 0.99, with one future resampling node. These are distinct populations and clocks.

Whole-window high-versus-low selection strata show lower shape_xx (-0.495 z, CI [-0.648,-0.320], q=0.000813; negative in 13/14 batches) and shape_yy (-0.513, CI [-0.620,-0.424], q=0.0000149; negative in all 14). Pair kernels 1.5, 2.5 and 3.5 are higher (+0.562,+0.631,+0.540 z; positive in all batches; q<=0.000146), while kernel 7.0 is lower (-0.485, CI [-0.617,-0.357], q=0.000146; negative in all batches). These describe selection preference for coordinate proxies, without identifying beneficial chemistry or energy.

Localization is heterogeneous: regional soft mass is enriched at 00 (+0.639 z, CI [0.492,0.791], q=0.000188, 14/14 positive), 07 (+0.481, q=0.00739, 12/14 positive) and 10 (+0.395, q=0.000372, 14/14 positive), but depleted at 11 (-0.322, q=0.0227) and 12 (-0.257, q=0.0288). Local_cyy depletion occurs in separated landmarks, including 00 (-0.575), 07 (-0.646) and 16 (-0.672), all negative in 14/14 batches, alongside global shape_yy depletion. Repeated local covariance signals therefore may reflect common shape; overlapping Gaussian regions and absent conditional adjustments prevent claiming unique regional benefit beyond global motion.

Regional displacement contrasts differ from uniform global translation: landmark_06_local_dy is +0.425 z (CI [0.339,0.515], q=0.000115, 14/14 positive), while landmark_12_local_dy is -0.529 (CI [-0.677,-0.389], q=0.000411, 14/14 negative). Global centroid_y is -0.243 (q=0.0136, negative in 11/14 batches). Region 12 also has a negative parent-edge rate contrast (-4.144 standardized rate, CI [-6.321,-1.970], q=0.0233, negative in 13/14 batches). Opposing regional associations justify testing localization, but do not constitute a residualized or causal advantage over global fields.

Empirical node contrasts change sign within the complete observed window. Region 00 soft mass is positive at 43/50 nodes and peaks at t=0.16 (+1.641 z), yet moves from -0.366 at t=0 to -0.275 at t=0.49; it is negative at t=0.46-0.49. Region 06 local_dy is positive at 44/50 nodes but negative at t=0.45-0.49, ending -0.334. Region 07 local_cyy is negative at 46/50 nodes but positive at t=0.47-0.49, ending +0.296. Whole-window enrichment-change rates also differ, e.g. region 01 local_dz +1.621 (q=0.00196) and region 04 local_cyz +2.276 (q=0.00346). Endpoint enrichment, its change, and parent-edge contrasts are distinct measures; these observed sign changes do not establish precise transition times or physical velocities.

All 24 selected endpoint fitted curves have legendre_runtime_allowed=false. Relative node RMSE ranges from 0.386 to 0.931, exceeding the supplied <=0.35 criterion in every case. Examples of final observed-versus-fitted disagreements are shape_yy +0.163 versus -0.513, landmark_00_occupancy3 -0.0402 versus +0.545, and landmark_06_occupancy5 +0.270 versus -0.365. Whole-window association cannot justify using these fits as a continuous time rule; supplied empirical regional node functions are the available descriptive temporal evidence.

Some immediate-selection directions persist but attenuate in later survival: region 00 soft mass +0.639 becomes +0.365 z (CI [0.200,0.515], q=0.120, 12/14 positive), and region 07 local_cyy -0.646 becomes -0.299 (q=0.219, negative in 13/14 batches). None of the 400 supplied survival tests passes joint BH q<0.05; the minimum q is 0.1204. Ancestral diversity is limited: 349/700 batch-nodes have fewer than 3 ancestors and 531/700 fewer than 6; teachers per node range 17-28 with at most two per batch. This supports uncertainty-aware future-credit hypotheses, not a terminal affinity motif or an independent sample count based on descendants.

The incumbent program_20 has the largest supplied discovery mean_pic50_delta (+0.23030), valid-rate change +0.01, and MMFF relief per heavy median/p90 0.47695/0.95455. Program_3 has a similar mean (+0.22929) but p90 1.25258. Regional program_19 has lower mean (+0.21284) and slightly lower p90 (0.90787); program_5 has mean +0.21397 and p90 0.98105. Program_4 has the best single valid pIC50 (8.55804), but mean +0.22936 and valid-rate change -0.02; program_8 has a lower strain proxy p90 0.73102 but mean +0.13900. Means, maxima, validity, and physical tails favor different candidates. All rows are adaptive reused discovery batches without independent validation or supplied paired uncertainty.

hypotheses: Retain registered incumbent program_20 as the single candidate for a fresh paired generation comparison. Its registry specifies endpoint_pointcloud with endpoint_reference, native_rms_ratio=0.33, teacher_neighbors=4, teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2=4.0, teacher_score_beta=2.0, mixture_temperature=0.5 and time_ramp_power=0.0. This is a conservative candidate choice supported by the discovery mean and strain-tail tradeoff (quality:program_20, quality:program_3, quality:program_19), not a validated optimum or evidence that each scalar is individually optimal. Do not alter parameters from marginal selection statistics alone.

A localized association involving soft mass at 00/07/10 and opposing regional_y contrasts could add useful information to reward design, but defer adopting new region weights until a paired test establishes affinity benefit and acceptable physical tails beyond the common shape signal (regional_effects:0, regional_effects:70, regional_effects:100, regional_effects:62, regional_effects:122, quality:program_19).

Any future stage-dependent coordinate hypothesis should use the supplied observed-node functions, preserving sign changes and support at the exact learned nodes t=0.00-0.49. Defer a monotonic ramp, arbitrary time bins, or the disallowed endpoint Legendre fits; extrapolation to t=0.50 or later is unsupported. Native continuation after the window remains the declared contract (regional_curves, curve_support).

Defer switching to terminal-reference reward credit solely because a field correlates with survival. Sparse ancestry, failure of joint survival multiplicity correction, and discovery tradeoffs do not establish a superior terminal-affinity reward (lineage_support, survival_effects:0, quality:program_4, quality:program_6, quality:program_11). Validate the retained candidate on fresh paired generation batches using all attempts and failures, mean predicted affinity, and strain median and tails separately, without affinity-head gradients or additional production forward calls.

counterevidence.finding: Whole-window endpoint preferences mostly lack corrected parent-increment support. Shape_xx, shape_yy, pair_kernel_2.5 and region 00 occupancy3 rate contrasts have q=0.0951, 0.1606, 0.2082 and 0.0811 respectively. Only landmark_00_softmin survives q<0.05 among the 74 increment effects (-4.914 standardized rate, CI [-6.855,-2.616], q=0.0461; negative in 13/14 batches). A preferred endpoint state is not automatically a supported acceleration or drift direction.

Many observed node contrasts change sign, including strong whole-window regions, while all selected endpoint fits fail fidelity. The supplied node functions have no node-specific confidence intervals or batch-direction curves. Small local sign changes cannot be promoted into a validated schedule or exact reversal boundary.

Survival directions are suggestive but lose significance after joint BH correction. Future resampling, repeated descendants and sparse ancestors limit independent terminal credit. Lack of a future label must remain missing rather than becoming failed affinity; complete survival batches do not supply terminal-affinity field effect estimates.

Retaining program_20 is not an all-metric victory: program_19 has a smaller reported strain p90, program_8 smaller median and p90, and program_4 a better single valid score. Regional selection association therefore does not settle the affinity-versus-strain tradeoff, and the +0.23030 discovery mean may reflect adaptive reuse. No paired confidence interval, native strain baseline, material-regression margin or failure-level affinity outcomes is supplied.

The sparse-field versus fixed-frame teacher audit is not a complete reward comparison. Compressed teacher choice has mean excess fixed RMS 0.08097 A (batch CI [0.06970,0.09214]) and top-four overlap 0.46974, yet both teacher score correlations are modest: compressed 0.10183 and full 0.06408. These observational correlations are neither an independently validated affinity predictor nor evidence that the full reward, its gradient, or a specific registered program benefits final quality.

limitations: Only the frozen request and its bound evidence JSON were used. All 1,174 entries, registered-program metadata, support summaries and the 63 complete supported regional node functions were inspected numerically; protected trajectories, implementation files, other conditions and external material were not accessed.

Coordinate association is observational and selection conditioned. Untyped distance proxies and overlapping coordinate landmarks cannot establish chemical interactions, residue mechanisms, binding energies or causal affinity improvements. Conditional regional-versus-global comparisons are not supplied.

Independent uncertainty is at generation-batch level (14 where supplied), with parent-debiased local moments as specified. Node observations, children, teachers and repeated descendants do not constitute additional independent replicates. The evidence supplies no detailed missing-affinity-label counts.

Reported z state effects and standardized rates are different quantities; rates concern changing endpoint forecasts under model time. Exact feature formulas, all physical-unit definitions and node-specific uncertainty are not supplied. No observation at t=0.50 or later supports reward extrapolation.

Discovery quality summaries do not provide fresh validation, per-attempt failure outcomes, sample counts, paired batch effects, affinity uncertainty, a native strain baseline or a predefined material-regression margin. The retained reward is a test candidate; affinity improvement and strain non-regression remain unproved. Compilation and execution were not performed; compliance with the supplied execution contract must be checked by the shared compiler.
